# The in-tree tb-esmify migration command was removed after the ESM conversion

Bug 1895920 ported upstream Bug 1892103. The accepted commit removed the tb-esmify mach registration, its 707-line mach command, and its 417-line conversion map. Upstream Bugzilla states that in-tree code was fully converted to ECMAScript modules, so the in-tree migration tool no longer served its purpose and obscured code searches. Do not refer to tb-esmify as a current Thunderbird mach command; retrieve it from history only for an exceptional out-of-tree migration. The current checkout has no tb-esmify reference in build, tools or mail.

Scope: Build commands.

Paths:

- `build/mach_initialize.py`
